title: 133 New Filings in Two Months, 1,245 Generative AI Services Registered

content_html:
According to the Cyberspace Administration of China, between September and October 2026, 133 new generative AI services completed filing, and the filing information of 1 other service was changed. In this new batch of filings, two categories are worth noting: 3 provide mobile on-device generative AI services, and 1 provides human-like interactive generative AI services—on-device deployment and human-like interaction are becoming service types that regulators separately categorize.

API Calls Go Through the “Registration” Channel

In addition to directly launching model services, many applications choose to “leverage existing capabilities”: through API interfaces or other means, they directly call the capabilities of already-filed models. Such generative AI applications or functions do not need separate filing; instead, local cyberspace administrations carry out registration. This time, 224 new ones completed registration. Filing governs models, while registration governs applications; the two channels straighten out the chain of responsibility from underlying models to upper-layer applications. As of October 31, a total of 1,245 generative AI services had completed filing, and 955 generative AI applications or functions had completed registration, bringing the combined total to nearly 2,200.
